name: Return to Corporal Kaleb
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
While you were gone I fixed the pot you brought me.  I even added an extra steam whistle, and look!  There's a new chopper at the bottom that'll cut through leg bones!

Yes yes, Krazek's Crock Pot is a 100% cook pleaser!  I'm sure its owner will be satisfied.
narrative.objectives: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It's fixed! This is great, now I can get dinner started! Thanks so much, adventurer.

I hope you were okay in Booty Bay. That place can get pretty rough, and... I heard rumors that the goblins will sometimes drag drunk sailors to their slave boats and take them to who-knows-where... to do who-knows-what...
narrative.requestItemsText: Hello, adventurer. Did you make it to Booty Bay? Did the goblin Krazek fix my pot??

chain.subtitle: 3 quests at level 37, 6,350 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.

quests.name: Favor for Krazek
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 loads of Lesser Bloodstone Ore to Krazek in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Return to Corporal Kaleb
quests.objectiveText: Bring Krazek's Fixed Pot to Corporal Kaleb at the Rebel Camp.
